question: ______ is a condition in which tissues in the body fail to receive an adequate supply of oxygen.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hypoxia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Concept: **

 
 
• Hypoxia is a condition in which the body or a region of the body is deprived of adequate oxygen supply at the tissue level.
 
• Hypoxia may be classified as:
 
 
• ​Generalized, affecting the whole body
 
• Local, affecting a region of the body.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Explanation:**
 
 
• **​**Early signs of; hypoxia are anxiety, confusion, and restlessness.
 
• The nurse should suspect hypoxia in an unconscious client who suddenly becomes restless.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Low or depleted oxygen in a water body leads to 'dead zones '— regions where life cannot be sustained.
 
• In the ocean and freshwater environments, the term "hypoxia" refers to low or depleted oxygen in a water body.
 
• Early signs of hypoxia are anxiety, confusion, and restlessness; if hypoxia is not corrected, hypotension will develop.
 
• As hypoxia worsens, the patient's vital signs, activity tolerance, and level of consciousness will decrease.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Memory loss is a symptom of Alzheimer's or other dementia.
 
• Alzheimer's is a brain disease that causes a slow decline in memory, thinking, and reasoning skills.
 
• Vitamin B-12 deficiency is found mostly in older adults and vegetarians and can cause various signs and symptoms, including memory loss.
 
• Alzheimer's disease is a progressive disorder that causes brain cells to waste away (degenerate) and die.
 
• Alzheimer's disease is the cause of dementia is a continuous decline in thinking, behavioral, and social skills that disrupts a person's ability to function independently.
 
• Alzheimer's disease is thought to be caused by the abnormal build-up of proteins in and around brain cells.
 
• One of the proteins involved is called amyloid, deposits of which form plaques around brain cells.
 
• The other protein is called tau, deposits of which form tangles within brain cells.
